description:
Render a Skin Lab outfit, gun or item as an image (WebP/PNG). Returns `{status: "done", url, cached, width, height, format}` with a permanent image URL (same request = same
URL; images are cached), plus `outfit` (the normalised pieces, their Steam prices and `total_price` in USD cents,
and any clashes / invalid attachments dropped exactly as /skin-lab/outfit reports them), `viewer_url` (the same
outfit in the interactive 3D viewer) and `render_quota`. A render that takes longer than `wait` seconds answers
**202** `{status: "queued", position, retry_after}` - call again with the same parameters (no extra quota) after
`Retry-After` seconds. 429 when the render queue is full or a quota is used up. New images count against a
separate render quota (100 per key per UTC day); cached images don't. Use when someone wants to SEE an outfit, skin, gun or item: returns the rendered image inline (you can look at it and show it) plus a permanent image URL, the interactive 3D viewer link, the outfit's pieces and total Steam price. `pieces` uses the same format as skinlab_build_outfit (find skins with search_skins / skinlab_get_item); a gun with attachments in item view = mode `weapon`. Rendering a new image takes a few seconds; if it says pending, call again with the same arguments. Keyless use shares a small daily render budget.

background.description: `studio`, `dark`, `light`, `sky`, `sunset`, or an in-game scene: plains, forest, arctic, desert, beach, set_base, set_garage, set_compound, set_monument, set_launch, set_market, set_military, set_dock, set_coast.

face.description: Face (head) name for that body, e.g. `Frank` (default: the first face).

light.description: Lighting: studio, day, golden, overcast, dusk, night. `studio` on an in-game scene = that scene's own daylight.

mode.description: `outfit` (on the player), `weapon` (the FIRST piece on its own - guns, tools, deployables) or `pov` (first person; needs a gun or tool).

pieces.description: The outfit, exactly as for /skin-lab/outfit: comma-separated `item[:skin[:attachment~attachment]]` (item by shortname or name, skin by itemdefid or name, attachments for guns; a bare number is a skin itemdefid). Left out = the viewer's starter outfit.

pose.description: Pose key, e.g. `idle`, `wave`, `crouch`, `rifle_aim` (default `auto`). Moving poses are shown frozen.

transparent.description: Transparent backdrop (studio-type backgrounds only; the floor disc stays).

weather.description: In-game scenes only: auto, off, clear, cloudy, fog, rain, storm, snow.

name: skinlab_render_outfit
title: Render a Skin Lab outfit, gun or item as an image (WebP/PNG)
